content.short: Populate Bunny Island by collecting, breeding, and genetically modifying digital bunnies. 100% on-chain powered by Plutus smart contracts.
content.description:
Bunny Island aims to be the first completely decentralized breeding/collecting game. You will also be able to modify Bunnies genetically using in-game items. This will happen on-chain, entirely supervised by an uncompromising smart contract written in Plutus and running on the Cardano blockchain.

We will feature a new kind of NFT that allows state and meaningful interaction with Plutus smart contracts.
